# Servants

*Page PDF 14*

## **Landlords**
Landlords combine the Skills of the Townsman and the Artisan (many of them brew their own ale). Landlords need to be socially skilled, as even the poorest of them must be charming enough so as not to alienate their regulars. The more skilled landlords learn to be both garrulous with customers, efficient with staff management, adept at identifying a good deal on quality booze, and are competent brewers. The following stats represent a bare minimum, and many practiced landlords will possess a wider variety of Skills and Talents.

## **Servants**
Servants include bar staff, cleaners, potboys, and other members of staff who are not particularly skilled, but whose assistance is crucial for the smooth running of the tavern. The Servant Career is used as the basis of these characters, but as these are bar staff rather than Courtiers they are paid a lot less. Whilst Quality Servants do exist, even high-class taverns would rather pay for extra staff than provide better wages to more experienced servants.
